presets.name: 3delight-render
presets.title: 3Delight Render
presets.description: Renders exported 3Delight NSI files with renderdl, one frame per task.

presets.name: 3dsmax-render
presets.title: 3ds Max Render
presets.description: Renders a saved 3ds Max scene headless with 3dsmaxcmd on Windows workers, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: after-effects-queue-render
presets.title: After Effects Queue Render
presets.description: Renders everything a saved After Effects project has queued, as one task on one Windows or macOS worker, with aerender.

presets.name: after-effects-render
presets.title: After Effects Render
presets.description: Renders one render-queue item of a saved After Effects project with aerender on Windows or macOS workers, up to ten frames per task by default.

presets.name: arnold-kick-render
presets.title: Arnold Kick Render
presets.description: Renders exported Arnold scene files with kick, one frame per task.

presets.name: arnold-kick-tile-render
presets.title: Arnold Kick Tile Render
presets.description: Renders each frame of exported Arnold scene files as a grid of kick render regions, then assembles the tiles into one image with oiiotool.

presets.name: blender-batch-render
presets.title: Blender Batch Render
presets.description: Renders a saved .blend file headless with Blender's batch mode, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: blender-view-layer-render
presets.title: Blender View Layer Render
presets.description: Renders one named view layer of a saved .blend file headless with Blender's batch mode, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: cinema4d-render
presets.title: Cinema 4D Render
presets.description: Renders a saved Cinema 4D scene headless with Commandline, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: cinema4d-take-render
presets.title: Cinema 4D Take Render
presets.description: Renders one named take of a saved Cinema 4D scene headless with Commandline, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: ffmpeg-segment-transcode-bash
presets.title: FFmpeg Segment Transcode (Bash)
presets.description: Splits a video into fixed-length slices, transcodes each on a different worker, then joins them with a bash script, so it needs Linux or macOS workers.

presets.name: ffmpeg-segment-transcode-expr
presets.title: FFmpeg Segment Transcode (Portable)
presets.description: Splits a video into fixed-length slices, transcodes each on a different worker, then joins them with a template-generated file list so it runs on Linux, macOS and Windows workers alike.

presets.name: ffmpeg-segment-transcode-powershell
presets.title: FFmpeg Segment Transcode (PowerShell)
presets.description: Splits a video into fixed-length slices, transcodes each on a different worker, then joins them with a PowerShell script, so it needs Windows workers.

presets.name: ffmpeg-sequence-encode
presets.title: FFmpeg Sequence Encode
presets.description: Encodes a numbered image sequence into a single video file on one worker.

presets.name: ffmpeg-transcode
presets.title: FFmpeg Transcode
presets.description: Converts one video file to another format on a single worker, start to finish.

presets.name: fusion-render
presets.title: Fusion Render
presets.description: Renders a saved Fusion composition with Fusion Render Node, ten frames per task by default, writing wherever the comp's Savers say.

presets.name: fusion-saver-render
presets.title: Fusion Saver Render
presets.description: Renders one Saver of a saved Fusion composition with Fusion Render Node, ten frames per task by default. The Render Node runs the preset's own Lua script.

presets.name: houdini-rop-render
presets.title: Houdini ROP Render
presets.description: Renders a ROP from a saved Houdini hip file with hython, in frame chunks.

presets.name: husk-usd-render
presets.title: Husk USD Render
presets.description: Renders a USD stage with SideFX husk through Karma or any Hydra delegate, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: hython-script
presets.title: Run a Python Script in Houdini
presets.description: Loads a Houdini hip file and runs a Python script in that session, once per frame or chunk of frames.

presets.name: katana-render
presets.title: Katana Render
presets.description: Renders one named Render node of a saved Katana project in batch mode, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: keyshot-render
presets.title: KeyShot Render
presets.description: Renders a frame range of a saved KeyShot scene headless, ten frames per task by default, one numbered image file per frame.

presets.name: keyshot-studio-render
presets.title: KeyShot Studio Render
presets.description: Renders a frame range of one named studio of a saved KeyShot scene headless, ten frames per task by default, one numbered image file per frame.

presets.name: mantra-render
presets.title: Mantra Render
presets.description: Renders exported Mantra IFD files with mantra, one frame per task.

presets.name: maya-layer-render
presets.title: Maya Layer Render
presets.description: Renders one named render layer of a saved Maya scene with the Render batch command, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: maya-scene-render
presets.title: Maya Scene Render
presets.description: Renders every renderable layer of a saved Maya scene with the Render batch command, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: mistika-boutique-render
presets.title: Mistika Ultima & Boutique Render
presets.description: Renders a saved Mistika Ultima or Boutique project on the command line, in frame chunks.

presets.name: mistika-vr-render
presets.title: Mistika VR Render
presets.description: Renders a saved Mistika VR project on the command line, in frame chunks.

presets.name: mistika-workflows-render
presets.title: Mistika Workflows Render
presets.description: Renders a saved Mistika Workflows graph on the command line, in frame chunks.

presets.name: modo-pass-group-render
presets.title: Modo Pass Group Render
presets.description: Renders one named pass group of a saved Modo scene headless with modo_cl, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: modo-render
presets.title: Modo Render
presets.description: Renders a frame range of a saved Modo scene headless with modo_cl, one frame per task by default, using the scene's own render outputs.

presets.name: nuke-script-render
presets.title: Nuke Script Render
presets.description: Renders every enabled Write node of a saved Nuke script, in frame chunks.

presets.name: nuke-write-render
presets.title: Nuke Write Render
presets.description: Renders one named Write node from a saved Nuke script, in frame chunks.

presets.name: oiiotool-process
presets.title: OIIO Tool Process
presets.description: Converts or processes an image sequence with OpenImageIO's oiiotool: format conversion, resizing, colour conversion and more.

presets.name: prman-render
presets.title: RenderMan Render
presets.description: Renders exported RenderMan RIB files with prman, one frame per task.

presets.name: redshift-standalone-render
presets.title: Redshift Standalone Render
presets.description: Renders exported Redshift scene files with redshiftCmdLine, one frame per task.

presets.name: silhouette-render
presets.title: Silhouette Render
presets.description: Renders one named output node of one session of a saved Silhouette project with sfxcmd, ten frames per task by default.

presets.name: silhouette-render-all
presets.title: Silhouette Render All
presets.description: Renders every output node of the active session of a saved Silhouette project with sfxcmd, ten frames per task by default.

presets.name: test-render-bash
presets.title: Test Render (Bash)
presets.description: Simulates a render on any worker without a renderer installed, sleeping per frame and optionally failing or hanging chosen frames.

presets.name: test-render-powershell
presets.title: Test Render (PowerShell)
presets.description: Simulates a render on any Windows worker without a renderer installed, sleeping per frame and optionally failing or hanging chosen frames.

presets.name: test-steps-bash
presets.title: Test Steps (Bash)
presets.description: Simulates a three-step pipeline - render, publish, notify - so step dependencies and ordering can be exercised without a renderer.

presets.name: test-steps-powershell
presets.title: Test Steps (PowerShell)
presets.description: Simulates a three-step pipeline - render, publish, notify - on Windows workers, so step dependencies can be exercised without a renderer.

presets.name: unreal-mrq-job-render
presets.title: Unreal Movie Render Queue Job Render
presets.description: Renders one level sequence on one map with one Movie Render Queue config in an Unreal Engine 5 project, as a single task on a Windows or macOS worker, through the preset's own Python script.

presets.name: unreal-mrq-queue-render
presets.title: Unreal Movie Render Queue Queue Render
presets.description: Renders every job of a saved Movie Pipeline Queue asset in an Unreal Engine 5 project, as a single task on a Windows or macOS worker, through the preset's own Python script.

presets.name: unreal-mrq-shot-render
presets.title: Unreal Movie Render Queue Shot Render
presets.description: Renders one level sequence on one map with one Movie Render Queue config in an Unreal Engine 5 project, one task per shot, on Windows or macOS workers, through the preset's own Python script.

presets.name: usdrecord-render
presets.title: USD Record Render
presets.description: Renders image frames of a USD stage with Houdini's usdrecord, for quick review renders and turntables.

presets.name: vray-standalone-render
presets.title: V-Ray Standalone Render
presets.description: Renders an exported V-Ray scene with V-Ray Standalone, one frame per task by default.

presets.name: vred-render
presets.title: VRED Render
presets.description: Renders a saved VRED scene headless with VRED Core, ten frames per task by default, using the scene's own render settings.

presets.name: vred-viewpoint-render
presets.title: VRED Viewpoint Render
presets.description: Renders one named viewpoint or camera of a saved VRED scene headless with VRED Core, ten frames per task by default.
